chunks: Muhammad ibn Ibrahim ibn Ishaq al-Talqani (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us, saying: Al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Adawi narrated to us, from 'Ibad ibn Suhaib [ibn 'Ibad Suhaib], from his father, from his grandfather, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him), who said:

A man asked the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) and said to him: 'I ask you about three characteristics that are in you: I ask you about your short stature, and about your large belly, and about the baldness of your head.' The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) replied: 'Indeed, God, the Blessed and Exalted, did not create me tall, nor did He create me short, but He created me of medium height. I strike the short one and cut him in two, and I strike the tall one and cut him in two. As for my large belly, it is because the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) taught me a door of knowledge, and that door opened a thousand doors for me, so knowledge crowded into my belly and caused my body to swell. And as for the baldness of my head, it is from the constant wearing of the helmet and wrestling with peers.'

key_terms.الْبَيْضُ: Helmet (specifically the iron helmet worn by warriors)

ai.seo_question: What are the reasons behind Imam Ali's physical characteristics according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from *Al-Khisal* highlights the physical attributes of Imam Ali (AS) as signs of his unique spiritual and martial status, linking his bodily form to divine wisdom. His 'medium' stature symbolizes balance and adaptability in combat, while his distended belly is a metaphor for the overwhelming influx of prophetic knowledge, and his baldness serves as a visible mark of his enduring sacrifice in the battles of Islam.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 3-261 Muhammad ibn Ibrahim ibn Ishaq al-Taleqani - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Al-Hassan ibn Ali al-Ado’we quoted Ebad ibn Saheeb (ibn Ebad ibn Saheeb), on the authority of his father, on the authority of his forefather, on the authority of Ja’far ibn Muhammad as-Sadiq (MGB), “A man asked the Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali (MGB) about his medium height, big belly and lack of hair on his forehead.

The Commander of the Faithful (MGB) replied, ‘The Blessed the Sublime God has created me neither tall nor short, but of medium height so that I can cut a short enemy into two pieces from head to toe, and cut a tall enemy into two pieces from his waist. My belly is big since the Prophet (MGB) opened up to me a gate of knowledge from which a thousand doors to knowledge shall open up. Therefore, knowledge gathered up in my belly. And the reason why there is no hair on my forehead is that I have always worn a head armor and gone to fight with the enemy.”
